target.statement: Sparse-SM achieves ARI = 0.471 (0.083) on the Gaussian simulation setting (K=3, AR(1) covariance, sp=p/20 informative features), outperforming K-means, K-median, SKMeans, SKMedian.
target.dataset: Synthetic Gaussian mixture (AR(1) covariance, 3 clusters, sp=p/20 shifted coordinates), generated by the paper's own DGP

compute.basis: No code released, so the full Sparse-SM pipeline (Weiszfeld spatial medians, hard-threshold screening, permutation-based Gap tuning over a tau grid with B permutations, plus baselines) must be reimplemented from the paper; data is synthetic and cheap, but the Gap tuning multiplies runtime by (1+B)*|tau grid| per replication, and the table averages over many replications.

blockers: No code or supplementary material linked in the paper
Exact simulation parameters (p, n0, tau grid, B, number of replications, initialization scheme) are only partially specified, so exact numeric match is unlikely
Permutation-based Gap tuning over a threshold grid is computationally heavy and must be reimplemented
title: Sparse $K$-spatial-median clustering for high-dimensional data
